_pack.name: coding-agent
_pack.description: For a CLI coding agent (Claude Code). Refuses a shell command whose text was derived verbatim from tool output, and asks a human. Measured: catches copy-able injections (8/8 verbatim on a susceptible model); does NOT catch a payload the model paraphrased.
_pack.scope: Start in shadow. This is a floor to tighten from your own traffic, not a finished policy.
